name: Gray-Scott
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" header_type="UInt32" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="6">
    <description>
      Self-replicating spots.
      
    </description>
    <rule name="Gray-Scott" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex">
      <param name="timestep">
        1.000000
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.174000
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.089900
      </param>
      <param name="k">
        0.059180
      </param>
      <param name="F">
        0.013900
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_k">
        -0.003500
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_F">
        0.050000
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_a">
        -0.005000
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_b">
        -0.002000
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_Da">
        0.020000
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_Db">
        0.000000
      </param>
      <param name="D_a_to_c">
        0.000000
      </param>
      <param name="D_b_to_c">
        0.000000
      </param>
      <param name="cDamp">
        0.000700
      </param>
      <param name="D_c">
        0.005000
      </param>
      <param name="a_to_c">
        0.000000
      </param>
      <param name="b_to_c">
        0.004200
      </param>
      <param name="c_pow">
        1.000000
      </param>
      <param name="c_pow_norm">
        1.000000
      </param>
      <param name="wave_diffusion">
        0.000004
      </param>
      <param name="wave_damp">
        0.999998
      </param>
      <param name="wave_power">
        1.001500
      </param>
      <param name="a_wave">
        0.000000
      </param>
      <param name="b_wave">
        0.007000
      </param>
      <param name="c_wave">
        -0.001100
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="6" block_size_x="4" block_size_y="1" block_size_z="1" accuracy="medium">
        delta_a = (D_a + c*c_to_Da) * laplacian_a - a*b*b + (F+c_to_F*c)*(1.0f-a) + (c*c_to_a);
        delta_b = (D_b  + c*c_to_Db) * laplacian_b + a*b*b - ((F+c_to_F*c)+(k+c*c_to_k))*b + (c*c_to_b);
        delta_c = -c*cDamp + a*a_to_c + b*b_to_c + D_a_to_c * laplacian_a + D_b_to_c * laplacian_b + D_c * laplacian_c;
        c = clamp( pow( fabs(c)/c_pow_norm, c_pow )*c_pow_norm, 0.0f, 1.0f );
        d = sign(d) * pow( fabs(d) * wave_damp, wave_power ) + a * a_wave + b * b_wave + c * c_wave;
        delta_e = laplacian_d * wave_diffusion;
        delta_d = e + delta_e;
        f = delta_c;
      </formula>
    </rule>
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="false" zero_first="true">
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite/>
        <constant value="0.7"/>
        <everywhere/>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite/>
        <white_noise low="0.01" high="0.199"/>
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.1" y="0.1" z="0.1"/>
          <point3D x="0.9" y="0.9" z="0.9"/>
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <subtract/>
        <other_chemical chemical="b"/>
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.2" y="0.2" z="0.6"/>
          <point3D x="0.4" y="0.5" z="0.8"/>
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
    </initial_pattern_generator>
    <render_settings>
      <surface_color r="1" g="1" b="1"/>
      <colormap value="spectral"/>
      <color_low r="0" g="0" b="0"/>
      <color_high r="1" g="1" b="1"/>
      <show_color_scale value="false"/>
      <show_multiple_chemicals value="false"/>
      <active_chemical value="f"/>
      <low value="-0.0003"/>
      <high value="0.001"/>
      <vertical_scale_1D value="30"/>
      <vertical_scale_2D value="15"/>
      <contour_level value="0.25"/>
      <cap_contour value="true"/>
      <invert_contour_cap value="false"/>
      <use_wireframe value="false"/>
      <show_cell_edges value="false"/>
      <show_bounding_box value="true"/>
      <show_chemical_label value="true"/>
      <slice_3D value="true"/>
      <slice_3D_axis value="z"/>
      <slice_3D_position value="0.5"/>
      <show_displacement_mapped_surface value="false"/>
      <color_displacement_mapped_surface value="true"/>
      <use_image_interpolation value="true"/>
      <timesteps_per_render value="63"/>
      <show_phase_plot value="false"/>
      <phase_plot_x_axis value="a"/>
      <phase_plot_y_axis value="b"/>
      <phase_plot_z_axis value="c"/>
      <plot_ab_orthogonally value="false"/>
    </render_settings>
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 255 0 255 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
